label: 2025 data, consumption and organic yields
description: Layer 6, the method update E5: the organic yield factors and the organic baseline. The default factor 0.808 is kept (Ponisio et al. 2015 find 0.808, Kniss et al. 2016 find 0.80); wheat, oats, barley, maize and soybeans move to the mean of the 2011 literature mean and the commercial ratio of Kniss et al. 2016; and the 2% constant in Yield!E2, the organic share already contained in the ABS yields, becomes 7% to match the new default share. At the short-term defaults the organic share equals the baseline, so organic has no effect on the result (the 1% that moving the default alone cost in 2025-consumption is removed); the long-term settings, which are 100% organic, change.
errata: Seufert et al. 2012 and de Ponti et al. 2012 crop-specific ratios were not reachable and are not used (analysis/organic_2025/README.md).
Rows other than the five crops keep the 2011 factors: the mean of the 2011 studies where there are three or more, 0.808 otherwise.
